Two separate Fe absorption studies were made in adult women (10 women/study). Fe absorption was based on the erythrocyte incorporation of stable isotopes ((57)Fe and (58)Fe) 14 days after the intake of labelled test meals of infant cereal (study 1) or yogurt drink (study 2).
